text:
Poetry, truth, my poem,

force of love that found your hands, far away,

in a flight of Junes polished mirrors

and found in light paleness, cold.


I overflowed the river's pitchers,

stopped the light in the old backwaters,

gave orders to all reflections;

perfect June gave its power.


Poetry, truth of every dream,

never have I been a shorter owner of you

than in this master in whose clouds I die.


Flee from me, turn me into your oblivion,

into impossible time, into the first

of all memories of oblivion.

translation.title: Poetry
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the address to poetry and the paradox of becoming memory inside oblivion.
